svg.title: Vector derivation of the specular-reflection direction
svg.desc: The left panel shows incident direction d pointing toward a planar splitter, reflected direction d r, unit normal n, and theta equal to the angle between minus d and n and to the angle between d r and n. The right panel translates the free vectors to a shared origin O; it is not a second ray path. It decomposes d into tangential component d parallel and normal component d perpendicular. Reflection leaves d parallel unchanged and reverses d perpendicular, giving d r equals d minus two times d dot n times n.
svg.text: Specular reflection: keep the tangent component, reverse the normal component
d points in the direction of propagation toward the surface; n is a unit surface normal
1 — Ray geometry at the hit point P

g.data-original-text: <text x="250" y="344" text-anchor="middle" class="label">θ = ∠(−d, n) = ∠(d<tspan dy="3" font-size="10">r</tspan><tspan dy="-3">, n)</tspan></text>
g.title: θ = ∠(−d, n) = ∠(dr, n)

svg.text: equal angles follow when the normal component
changes sign and the tangent component does not
With n facing the incident half-space:
translated free vectors share origin O — not a second ray path

g.data-original-text: <text x="689" y="286" text-anchor="middle" class="label">d<tspan dy="3" font-size="10">∥</tspan><tspan dy="-3"> = d − (d · n)n</tspan></text>
g.title: d∥ = d − (d · n)n

g.data-original-text: <text x="841" y="375" class="label violet">d<tspan dy="3" font-size="10">⊥</tspan><tspan dy="-3"> = (d · n)n</tspan></text>
g.title: d⊥ = (d · n)n

g.data-original-text: <text x="682" y="390" class="label amber">d = d<tspan dy="3" font-size="10">∥</tspan><tspan dy="-3"> + d</tspan><tspan dy="3" font-size="10">⊥</tspan></text>
g.title: d = d∥ + d⊥

g.data-original-text: <text x="678" y="206" class="label teal">d<tspan dy="3" font-size="10">r</tspan><tspan dy="-3"> = d</tspan><tspan dy="3" font-size="10">∥</tspan><tspan dy="-3"> − d</tspan><tspan dy="3" font-size="10">⊥</tspan></text>
g.title: dr = d∥ − d⊥

g.data-original-text: <text x="731" y="500" text-anchor="middle" class="formula">d<tspan dy="4" font-size="12">r</tspan><tspan dy="-4"> = d − 2(d · n)n</tspan></text>
g.title: dr = d − 2(d · n)n
